_comment: The cylinder borer's build (CylinderBorer/README.md, 'Build order', #639): its four stages after the frame and their materials, in the only order they go in; read by Machines/Core/MachineBuildJson.cs (its schema) and kept by the shared machine base (docs/modeling/machine-base.md). The bushings are one lot of the game's metal parts; the boring bar three rods, metal parts for its feather and collars and a large stainless gear for its great wheel; the feed two oak planks, a rod, two ropes and a plate; a material a click, the rods and plates of iron, meteoric iron or steel. The cutter head is the wearing part, fitted as the last stage and durable: it goes in with the durability it has left (uses is the head item's durability, set when the game loads), is worn by CylinderBorerSettings.HeadWearPerCylinder over the oil's fill a cylinder, comes back out by Ctrl with what is left, and a spent one is gone. No block: the borer's records are its own in the recipe export, not the ore machines' generic ones.
